system.description:
Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You close your eyes and listen through your fingertips for the lockmaker’s last little secret.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
One adjacent ordinary lock.
Duration
Opening progress persists; information remains known.
Equipment / acquisition
Lock tools required; gain one set, Bulk 1, on learning if absent.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Use lock tools on one adjacent ordinary lock. An attempt takes a Main Action, including under pressure. The DA states the opening target and consequences before the attempt; accumulate progress toward opening it.

Weak
Add 1 progress and learn whether the lock shows damage or tampering.
Standard
Add 2 progress and learn the same detail.
Strong
Add 3 progress and learn the same detail. If this opens it, you can later relock it with your tools in one Maneuver without rolling.

Source: design/cards/a-lock-has-a-language.md at 295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf.
